clue.text: Your English bourbons lack our all round superiority

indicators.note: all round suggests the pieces turned around and rearranged, so the collected letters are mixed
the bourbons lack the word our, so those three letters are taken out of it

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A boast that a rival's English bourbon biscuits fall short of ours in every way.
explanation.walkthrough: Bourbons here are British chocolate sandwich biscuits; YR for 'your' is an old written abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Snobbery is an attitude of looking down on others, a claimed social superiority.

clue.text: Cuts reversed, overshadowing Republican movement

indicators.note: overshadowing means covering over, so the reversed word encloses the letter
reversed says the word is read backwards

parts.note: edits are cuts made to a text

explanation.surface: Budget cuts are undone, overshadowing a Republican political movement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' turns EDITS into STIDE; 'overshadowing' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A stride is a long step, a single movement of walking.

clue.text: Whistler's Mother couldn't exist without them to lubricate Father in discontented times

definitions.text: Whistler's Mother couldn't exist without them

parts.note: to oil something is to lubricate it
pa is an informal word for father
taken as written

indicators.note: discontented means emptied of its contents, leaving the first and last letters

explanation.surface: A painting's mother needs grease for her father in unhappy times.
explanation.walkthrough: Whistler's Mother is a famous painting by James McNeill Whistler, done in oils; 'discontented' leaves TS from times.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous portrait was painted in oil paints, so without them the work could not exist.

clue.text: It helps to set the mood in country, perhaps, with history

definitions.text: It helps to set the mood

parts.note: someone's background is their history
country is an example of a kind of music

explanation.surface: Something that helps set a nation's mood, along with its past.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country' looks like a nation; it is country music.
explanation.definitionFit: Background music plays quietly to create an atmosphere in a film, shop or restaurant.

clue.text: A little red setter almost eating Oscar award

indicators.note: eating means taking in, so one piece goes inside the others
a little of the word means just its first letter
almost means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A small red setter dog gobbles up an Oscar statuette.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A little' gives R; 'almost' cuts setter to SETTE; 'eating' puts O between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosette is a rosebud-shaped badge of ribbon given as a prize at shows.

clue.text: On ABBA's tour, oddly, Bjorn's first to imbibe

indicators.note: oddly takes the letters in the odd-numbered places of the phrase
first takes just the opening letter of the Swedish singer's name

explanation.surface: On the band's tour, Bjorn strangely was the first to start drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes A, B, S, O, R from ABBA'S TOUR; 'first' adds B from Bjorn's.
explanation.definitionFit: To absorb something is to take it in or soak it up, just as imbibing does.

clue.text: Train badly broken — dread not starting — is this a way to solve the problem?

definitions.text: a way to solve the problem

indicators.note: broken means smashed apart, so the letters are rearranged
not starting means without its first letter

parts.note: terror is extreme dread

explanation.surface: A train breaks down and fearful passengers wonder how to fix it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken' rearranges TRAIN BADLY into BY TRIAL AND; 'not starting' cuts TERROR to ERROR.
explanation.definitionFit: Trial and error is solving a problem by testing attempts until one works.

clue.text: Known about eccentric

parts.note: once something is out it is publicly known
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is famous for being odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Outre means unconventional or bizarre, beyond the bounds of the usual.

clue.text: Singer, but for one vocal inflection

parts.note: bar means except or but for
I is the Roman numeral for one
tone is the inflection of the voice

explanation.surface: A singer who would be fine except for one odd lilt in the voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A baritone is a male singer with a voice between tenor and bass.

clue.text: Copies cancelled over Persian king, once

indicators.note: cancelled means struck out, so the letter is removed

parts.note: xeroxes are photocopies
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: Duplicate documents about an ancient ruler are destroyed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cancelled' takes O out of XEROXES.
explanation.definitionFit: Xerxes was a ruler of the ancient Achaemenid Persian empire.

clue.text: Fossil fuel finally found in most of the German state

indicators.note: found in says one piece is located within another, so the letter goes inside
most of drops the final letter of the word

parts.note: the Reich was the German state, notably under the Nazis

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word fuel

explanation.surface: Fossil fuel deposits are discovered in most of Germany.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims REICH to REIC; 'finally' gives L from fuel, which goes into it.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is something surviving from the past, and a fossil is used figuratively for an outdated survivor.

clue.text: Doctor protects a witness

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with or alter, so the letters that follow are rearranged

explanation.surface: A physician shields someone who saw a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a noun, the subject; it is a verb telling you to rearrange PROTECTS A.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectator is an onlooker who sees an event, and to witness is to see it happen.

clue.text: One pulls defender over, then it's hard to cross

indicators.note: over in this clue says the word is turned over, read from end to start

parts.note: a guard is someone who defends
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard
X is the shape of a cross

explanation.surface: A footballer pulls down a defender, then finds it tough to deliver a cross.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns GUARD to DRAUG.
explanation.definitionFit: A draught ox is an animal used for hauling a plough or cart, a beast of burden that pulls.

clue.text: Where Rugby Union needs to go to make it break out is silly

parts.words: Where Rugby Union needs to go
parts.note: the place RU must be put: inside the remaining letters, so this phrase gives the word for that position

indicators.note: to make it says the rest is the word for break out with RU taken away, since restoring RU remakes it

parts.note: to erupt is to break out

explanation.surface: Telling Rugby Union to move somewhere just to cause a breakout is a foolish plan.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue works backwards: ERUPT without RU is EPT, and RU must go IN EPT to make it erupt again, so IN + EPT.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept means clumsy or incompetent, and a foolish, silly action is an inept one.

clue.text: Petition against becoming judge — it's funny to some

indicators.note: becoming says one letter turns into another, so a letter is replaced

parts.note: to invoke is to call on or petition for help
V, short for versus, means against

explanation.surface: An appeal against being made a judge is something only a few find amusing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'becoming' swaps V for J in INVOKE.
explanation.definitionFit: An in-joke is a joke understood only by a particular group, so only some people get the humour.

clue.text: Kind of chip in fossil I conserved

indicators.note: in says the answer sits inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A fragment of rock found inside a fossil I kept safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points into fosSIL I CONserved.
explanation.definitionFit: Silicon is the semiconductor element from which computer chips are made.

clue.text: College students abandon dance supporting Hawaii's state capital

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue means placed beneath, so this piece comes after

parts.note: HI is the postal abbreviation for Hawaii

indicators.note: abandon means leave behind, so these letters are taken out

parts.note: the hula-hula is the Hawaiian dance, also called the hula
L stands for learner or student, two of them

explanation.surface: College students give up dancing to back Hawaii's capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandon' takes both Ls (learners) out of HULAHULA; 'supporting' puts the remainder under C and HI.
explanation.definitionFit: Chihuahua city is the capital of the Mexican state of the same name.

clue.text: Robinson Crusoe was once this unsuccessful

definitions.meaning: the castaway was carried ashore on a desert island by the sea
... describes someone whose career is finished, a failure

explanation.surface: A famous castaway was a failure in his day.
explanation.definitionFit: Washed up means literally carried ashore by waves, and figuratively failed or finished.

clue.text: As nice cycling as taking runs to begin with

definitions.note: As is the chemical symbol for this element, a noun

indicators.note: to begin with says this piece comes at the start of the answer
taking says one piece takes in another, which goes inside it

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: cycling moves letters round from one end of the word to the other

explanation.surface: A puzzling sentence comparing niceness and cycling with taking runs at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking' puts R in AS for ARS, which 'to begin with' places first; 'cycling' moves NICE's final E to the front, making ENIC. As is the chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: As is the symbol on the periodic table for the poisonous element arsenic.

clue.text: Vacuous celebrity advertising American island

indicators.note: vacuous means empty, so the word is emptied of its inner letters

parts.note: PR, public relations, is publicity or advertising

explanation.surface: An empty-headed celebrity promoting an American island resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vacuous' empties celebrity to CY.
explanation.definitionFit: Cyprus is an island nation in the eastern Mediterranean.

clue.text: New shelter, essentially, in case it's bright

indicators.note: in puts the letters inside the word for case

parts.note: a suit is a legal case

indicators.note: essentially takes the essence, the central letter of the word

explanation.surface: Install a new shelter just in case the weather turns sunny.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' gives L, the centre of shelter; 'in' places N and L inside SUIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunlit means lit by the sun, so a place in sunshine is bright.

clue.text: Project acquiring lead price comparison website

indicators.note: acquiring means taking on, so one word holds the other

parts.note: to shoot is to project or propel forward
Pb is the chemical symbol for lead

explanation.surface: A project gains a business lead through a site comparing prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lead' looks like a sales tip; it is the metal, symbol Pb.
explanation.definitionFit: A shopbot is software that searches online shops for the best prices.

clue.text: Weak model beefed up secretly

indicators.note: up in a down clue means read upwards, from bottom to top
secretly says the letters are concealed inside the words

explanation.surface: A frail fashion model was covertly bulked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'secretly' finds ELBEEF in modEL BEEFed; 'up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeble means lacking strength, which is what weak means.

clue.text: Drone getting to grips with reasonably hot air

indicators.note: getting to grips with means holding on to, so one word clasps the other

parts.note: a drone is a low, steady hum
OK means reasonably good, all right

explanation.surface: An unmanned aircraft coping with fairly warm air currents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drone' looks like the aircraft; it is the sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Hokum is nonsense, and hot air is empty, boastful talk.

clue.text: Last bit of Kubrick film about politician is neat

indicators.note: last bit of means the final letter of the name
about means surrounding, so one word goes around the other

parts.note: ET is the Spielberg film about an alien
MP is a Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: The ending of a Kubrick film about a politician is tidy.
explanation.walkthrough: The film is not Kubrick's: ET is Spielberg's alien film, and MP is a British Member of Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: Kempt, the rare positive of unkempt, means tidy or well groomed.

clue.text: Try clever style of writing for introduction

indicators.note: for introduction says this piece comes first, as an opener

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language, a style of writing
cute can mean clever or shrewd

explanation.surface: Advice to attempt a smart writing style for an opening paragraph.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Try' is the legal sense: to prosecute is to bring a case before a court.
explanation.definitionFit: To try a defendant in court is to prosecute them, the legal meaning of the verb.

clue.text: Disappointment as magician's debut is defined by assorted bad quips

indicators.note: is defined by means bounded or outlined by, so this letter sits within the others
assorted means mixed up, so the letters are rearranged
debut means first appearance, so the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: A magician's first show flops because it is full of poor jokes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'debut' gives M, which 'is defined by' puts inside the anagram of BAD QUIPS, from 'assorted'.
explanation.definitionFit: A damp squib is an event that fails to impress, like a firework that will not go off.

clue.text: The man visiting pub returned here to dry out

indicators.note: returned means turned back, so the whole is read backwards
visiting means calling in, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a bar is a pub
he refers to a man

explanation.surface: A man came back to the pub and needs to sober up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'visiting' puts HE in BAR (BHEAR); 'returned' turns that to REHAB.
explanation.definitionFit: Rehab is a clinic for treating addiction, where alcoholics go to stop drinking.

clue.text: Incite school rebellion

parts.note: to put someone up to something is to incite them

explanation.surface: Stir up an uprising among pupils.
explanation.definitionFit: A putsch is a sudden attempt to overthrow a government, a coup or uprising.

clue.text: Celebrity magazine dismissing mother in revealing daydream

parts.note: a star is a celebrity

indicators.note: dismissing means sending away, so these letters are removed

parts.note: MA is a familiar word for mother
taken as written

explanation.surface: A celebrity magazine leaves out a mother featured in a candid fantasy piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dismissing' takes MA and IN out of MAGAZINE, leaving GAZE.
explanation.definitionFit: To stargaze is to be lost in idle thought, gazing at the sky, which is to daydream.
